Leipzig, Saxe, Allemagne
Internship Project – Sag Monitoring of High Voltage Power Lines based on
Image Processing
Project Description:
This project aimed to develop a solution for monitoring the condition of high-
voltage power lines using image processing. The goal was to identify issues
related to the sagging of the lines, which can be caused by environmental
or mechanical factors, in order to prevent risks and improve infrastructure
management.
Tasks Completed:
■ Detection of cables without the background: Developed an algorithm
to identify high-voltage power line cables without their background, using
advanced image processing techniques.
■ Sag calculation of the lines: Implemented a method to measure the sag of
the cables using image analysis and calculations based on the geometry of the
power lines.
■ Image analysis: Preprocessed images captured by drones or cameras,
segmented the cables, and applied filters to improve the accuracy of the
results.
■ Algorithm optimization: Enhanced the efficiency of the detection and
measurement algorithms for faster and more reliable results.
Technical Environment:
Python, OpenCV for image processing, along with specific libraries for
mathematical calculations and real-time image analysis.
